evidence: The actual frozen XLSX was read with openpyxl: Quality Checks!A13:D13 identifies row 12 and requires "[environment].docker_image isn't set while the agent Dockerfile still has active build steps"; Internal Quality Checks!A13:D13 repeats that condition (no additional annotation). Frozen harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/quality-checks.md:53-54 and staged-task-contract.md:78 agree. The entire frozen task/task.toml was parsed with Python 3.12 tomllib. Its [environment] at task/task.toml:20-24 contains exactly build_timeout_sec=600.0, network_mode="public", cpus=2, memory_mb=4096; parsed membership test for docker_image returned False. This is a semantic parse, not a text-only absence check. task/environment/Dockerfile:5-7 contains active apt installation, :9-12 installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1, :14-15 COPYs instructions and assets, and :16-23 initializes /app. No prebuilt image override bypasses these steps. The entire separate task/tests/Dockerfile was also inspected; task/task.toml:28 explicitly selects environment_mode="separate", so its two FROM lines are verifier build instructions rather than an agent image override. A search across every shipped TOML, shell, Python and Dockerfile found no docker_image setting. Parsed frozen template [environment] has the same four keys and the agent Dockerfile is byte-identical to its frozen template counterpart. SHA256 checks against manifest.json confirmed all ten relevant task/rule/template files and current review policy. In particular task.toml=17d5c69747a3c372b8fb1270a651cdff8b7a23a0e0ec9f03d7c026fbe6454802, environment/Dockerfile=0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1, workbook=6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f. CONFIRMED describes this static configuration and parser observation only; no Docker, full configured judge, Oracle or target-model run was performed or inferred. Those runtime measurements are unnecessary to establish absence of this configuration key and remain unmeasured outside this row.
counterexample: Read-only, in-memory parser witnesses were executed against the candidate TOML. Conforming alternative: inserting the comment # docker_image = "example/prebuilt:1" under [environment] leaves docker_image absent; tomllib returned False, avoiding a false failure from a bare substring search. Broken alternative: inserting the valid quoted key "docker_\u0069mage" = "example/prebuilt:1" under [environment] while retaining the active Dockerfile decoded to docker_image; tomllib returned True, detecting a setting a literal docker_image search could miss. Neither witness changed frozen source. An initial dotted-key witness was rejected by tomllib as a duplicate table declaration and was discarded; it is not used as evidence of a valid broken configuration.
